Introduction

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation

items:
Make sure C.T secondary circuit are shorted at the incoming terminal 
 blocks before isolating the relay current circuit for test.

Obtain copy of relay setting from 
 field maintenance file and compare it with the setting on this relay.

sections.text: Testing the Relay
Connect the test leads between the current terminals ( 1 - 2 ).

Connect 
the test leads between the trip contact ( 7 - 8 ).
Increase the current slowly until the relay picks up ( start ).

Record the 
 current and time values in the test sheet.
Continue increasing the current until the relay trips.
Record the current and time values in the test sheet.

sections.text:
Return Relay and Associated Equipment to 
Service

items:
Return relay to service by removing the 
 test leads from the relay terminal block and the test set i.e.
 - 
Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( 1 - 2 )
 - Disconnect the test leads between the trip contact 
 ( 7 - 8 )

Return relay to service by removing the 
 test leads from the relay terminal block and the test set i.e.
 - 
Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( 1 - 2 )
 - Disconnect the test leads between the trip contact 
 ( 7 - 8 )

Make sure CT and VT secondary circuits 
 are in normal condition.

If any equipment associated with the 
 relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
 - Breaker trip coils.
 - Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.
